pkgmetadata.longdescription: plang is an LLVM-based Pascal compiler. It implements ISO 7185 Standard Pascal (level 1) and ISO 10206 Extended Pascal; Turbo Pascal support is under development. The driver uses llc and ld.lld from the selected LLVM slot, and GCC's crt/libgcc at link time. Tests are a driver smoke compile, not the upstream GoogleTest/lit suite.
